---
title: Cold Rice with Herring
id: MAR-0065
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 30
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 200 g parboiled rice
- 5 anchovy fillets in oil
- 2 smoked herring fillets
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 10 chives
- 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 1 tablespoon rice vinegar
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Cook the rice in boiling lightly salted water.
2. Cut the anchovies and herring into small pieces.
3. Drain the rice al dente and rinse it under running water.
4. Pour it into a salad bowl, season with oil, vinegar, a grind of pepper, and a pinch of salt.
5. Add the anchovies and herring to the rice, the chives cut with scissors, sprinkle with parsley, and mix.
